sections.title: Sound of letter i kratkoye
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (и краткое) /i ˈkratkəjə/. It makes one main sound, heard in (йогурт) /ˈjoɡʊrt/, which means yogurt. This letter has only one sound in Russian. It never changes to another sound.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Raise the middle of your tongue close to the hard roof of your mouth. Keep the tongue tip low behind your bottom teeth. Turn your voice on and let the air flow smoothly over the tongue. Touch your throat to feel the vibration of your voice.

sections.title: Reading this letter
paragraphs: This letter always makes the same sound. It appears as a semivowel at the start or in the middle of words like (йогурт) /ˈjoɡʊrt/. It also stands after vowels at the end of syllables, like in the word (май) /maj/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not stretch this letter into a long vowel like the sound in see. It is a quick glide, exactly like the consonant sound in yes. Keep it very short.
